review_candidates.title: Sales Team Manager - Manufacturing & Industrial unit
review_candidates.description: Sales Team Manager – Manufacturing & Industrial Unit Ready to take the next step in your sales leadership career and help drive growth in one of Europe’s most exciting B2B businesses? Are you a hands-on sales leader who enjoys coaching people, building relationships, winning deals, and driving commercial results? We are looking for a Sales Team Manager to join our growing Manufacturing & Industrial Business Unit in our Barcelona office and play a key role in our next phase of growth. We have already built a strong Industrial Sales team, and now we’re looking for a leader who can help us take our commercial performance to the next level. You’ll lead and develop your own team, strengthen sales execution, and contribute to expanding our presence in the Manufacturing & Industrial vertical. This is a player-manager role where you’ll combine team leadership with direct sales involvement. You’ll coach your team, support strategic customer conversations, help close deals, and take ownership of your team’s results. You won’t be building from scratch or figuring everything out alone: you’ll work alongside experienced sales leaders in an international organization, with the opportunity to make a visible impact on the unit’s growth. In This Role, You Will Lead and develop your team. Run 1:1s, coach sales professionals, support onboarding, and build a team culture where people perform, collaborate, and grow. Lead by example. Stay close to the sales process by joining customer conversations, supporting negotiations, influencing strategic opportunities, and contributing directly to revenue. Drive commercial performance. Take ownership of team KPIs, pipeline development, forecasting, and results, using data to identify opportunities and improve performance. Develop your people. Help your team sharpen their sales skills, achieve their targets, and progress in their careers through regular feedback and coaching. Grow the business. Support new business development, strengthen existing customer relationships, and identify opportunities to expand our commercial impact in the Manufacturing & Industrial vertical. Improve sales execution. Work with your team to strengthen prospecting, sales processes, deal strategy, and overall performance. Collaborate across teams. Share market insights and customer feedback with Product, Customer Success, and other commercial teams, while working closely with sales leaders across our European offices. What we’re looking for B2B sales experience. A strong track record of achieving commercial results, with hands-on experience across the sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation and closing. Team leadership experience. Experience leading, coaching, or developing an SDR/BDR team or a similar sales team, with clear examples of improving performance and helping others achieve their goals. Language skills. Bilingual-level German or French and fluency in English. Industrial market knowledge. A good understanding of the Manufacturing & Industrial business landscape, ideally with experience selling to companies in this vertical and building relationships with senior decision-makers. A consultative sales approach. The ability to understand customer needs, build compelling business cases, and navigate complex B2B sales conversations. A data-driven mindset. Confidence managing KPIs, pipeline, and forecasts, using performance insights to make decisions and improve results. A hands-on leadership style. You enjoy developing others but are equally comfortable getting involved in customer-facing sales activities and helping close deals. An AI-first mindset. You actively use AI tools to work smarter, improve your own sales execution, and support the development and performance of your team. A builder mentality. You take ownership, adapt to change, and are motivated by the opportunity to develop a team and contribute to an ambitious growth journey. What we offer Build the future of our Industrial growth journey Join us at an exciting stage of expansion. With an established presence in the Manufacturing & Industrial vertical and a strong local team already in place, you’ll have the opportunity to develop your own team, strengthen commercial performance, and help shape our next phase of growth. Performance rewarded You’ll receive an attractive compensation package including base salary, commission, and a starter bonus to support you as you ramp up and build momentum. Growth and learning From day one, you’ll receive a structured onboarding program and continuous development through our international AL Academy, with the tools and support to strengthen your leadership skills and progress in your career. Career opportunities across Europe With offices across Europe and beyond, there are opportunities to learn from experienced leaders, collaborate internationally, and develop your career as Aurora Live continues to grow. Recharge & Thrive We care about your wellbeing and want you to perform at your best. You can earn up to 12 additional vacation days annually. We win together Success is something we build as a team. We bring people together through company trips, international events, and local office celebrations. Annual Company Trip Every summer, employees from all offices come together in Finland for our annual company trip, combining learning, connection, teamwork, and celebration. Global community & diversity With colleagues from more than 50 nationalities, you’ll join an international environment where different perspectives and backgrounds drive innovation and success. To apply Please submit your application and CV. We encourage you to highlight: The sales teams you’ve led or developed, including their size and responsibilities. The KPIs you’ve owned and the commercial results you’re proud of. Examples of deals you’ve closed or helped your team close. Sales processes, coaching approaches, or improvements you’ve introduced. How you’ve helped sales professionals improve their performance and develop their careers. We’re looking for a leader who motivates their team, delivers results, and still loves selling - someone who leads by example and is ready to make an impact in our Manufacturing & Industrial unit. At Aurora Live , we’re transforming the way leaders connect, collaborate, and grow. Working with us means being part of an international, fast-paced, and purpose-driven company , where ambition meets action and every idea can make an impact. Our teams bring together smart, curious, and driven individuals who love what they do — connecting visionary leaders, shaping industries, and celebrating success along the way. Ready to be part of something extraordinary? Join us and help shape the future of business connections.

C’est donc être au cœur d’une formidable aventure technique. Une attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs au service de leur réussite. review_candidates.description: Regional Sales Manager – Core Line | Central America, Caribbean & Ecuador For more than 185 years, seca has been a global leader in medical precision and innovation. Our professional measuring solutions are used by healthcare institutions and professionals around the world. In Latin America, seca operates through a strong network of distributors across multiple markets. We are now looking for a Regional Sales Manager – Core Line to take commercial responsibility for Central America, the Caribbean and Ecuador . Location: Bogotá D.C., Colombia Work model: 100% on-site Territory: Central America, Caribbean & Ecuador Travel: Approximately 40–50% Reporting to: LATAM Director Contract: Indefinite-term employment contract The Opportunity The Regional Sales Manager will have full commercial responsibility for seca’s Core Line business across the assigned territory. Core Line includes seca’s professional medical weighing and measuring portfolio, including medical scales, stadiometers and professional weight-and-height measurement systems used in hospitals, clinics, healthcare institutions, public health programs and other medical environments. This is a mature and strategically important region with established distributors, existing business and significant growth potential. The main objective is to protect and grow the current business, strengthen distributor performance, develop new opportunities and ensure disciplined commercial execution across all assigned markets. This is a hands-on regional commercial role . The position has no direct reports. Leadership is exercised primarily through our distributors and their sales teams, combining strategic business management with regular market presence and direct involvement in key commercial projects. Key AccountabilitiesBusiness Ownership & Commercial Performance Take commercial ownership of Core Line sales across Central America, the Caribbean and Ecuador. Deliver regional sales targets and support sustainable, profitable growth. Build and maintain reliable sales forecasts. Manage pipeline, key opportunities and commercial priorities by country. Monitor sales performance, pricing, profitability and overall business development. Follow up on Purchase Orders, payments, deliveries and commercial commitments. Support inventory planning, stock levels, rotation and product availability. Distributor Management & Development Manage and develop relationships with seca distributors across the assigned territory. Conduct structured Business Reviews and commercial follow-up. Build annual business plans and define priorities together with distributor leadership. Support distributor sales teams in developing their markets and identifying new opportunities. Monitor distributor performance, execution and achievement against agreed targets. Maintain close relationships with distributor owners, commercial directors and key decision-makers. Market Development & Strategic Projects Develop new business opportunities together with local distributors. Support strategic accounts, hospitals, healthcare institutions and relevant customer projects. Participate in important negotiations and high-impact commercial opportunities. Support product presentations, commercial training and market development activities. Identify market trends, competitive activity, risks and new business opportunities. Support public tenders and institutional projects when relevant. Experience working with Ministries of Health, government institutions, NGOs, international organizations, public health programs, nutrition programs, early childhood initiatives or large institutional projects will be considered a major advantage. Regional Execution Travel regularly throughout Central America, the Caribbean and Ecuador. Conduct joint market visits with distributor sales teams. Maintain close visibility of key opportunities and strategic accounts. Ensure disciplined follow-up of major projects and commercial commitments. Provide relevant market intelligence and business updates to LATAM leadership. Maintain appropriate opportunity tracking and CRM discipline. The Profile We Are Looking For We are looking for a commercially strong professional who combines B2B experience, distributor management and hands-on execution . Someone capable of discussing annual business performance with a distributor owner or Commercial Director, while also being comfortable travelling with the distributor sales team to develop an important account or support a strategic opportunity. The ideal candidate should have: 5–8 years of proven commercial experience. Mandatory experience within Medical Devices or Healthcare B2B . Strong experience working with distributors, channels, Key Accounts or Business Development. Ideally 3–5 years of experience managing distributors or B2B commercial partners. Experience managing multiple countries, territories or markets is highly desirable. Previous LATAM or NOLA experience is a strong advantage. Strong commercial negotiation and closing skills. Ability to manage forecast, pipeline, orders and distributor performance in a structured way. Experience with public tenders is a plus. Experience with Ministries of Health, government entities, NGOs or international organizations is a major plus. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, International Business, Biomedical Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Health Sciences or a related field. Healthcare or clinical education combined with strong B2B commercial experience will be especially valued. Strong communication, presentation and relationship-building skills. High level of autonomy, accountability and results orientation. Willingness to travel approximately 40–50% of the time . Availability to work 100% on-site in Bogotá D.C. English A working level of English is required. Minimum B1. B2 or higher is strongly preferred. The candidate must be able to participate in meetings, training sessions and regular communication with international teams. What We Offer Responsibility for a consolidated and strategically important international territory. Direct management of distributor relationships across multiple countries. Exposure to private and public healthcare projects with regional impact. High level of commercial autonomy and direct interaction with LATAM leadership. Continuous product and commercial training. Opportunity to develop within a global German medical technology company. Indefinite-term employment contract. Competitive fixed salary plus monthly performance-based commission. Compensation Monthly base salary: COP $7,000,000 Target monthly variable compensation: approximately COP $4,000,000 Expected total monthly compensation at target performance: approximately COP $11,000,000 The variable component is linked to commercial performance and achievement of sales objectives. We are looking for someone who already understands Medical Devices B2B and distributor management, but still has the energy, ambition and hands-on mindset to take ownership of an international region and continue growing with seca.

Support the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes, transfers, performance management, and offboarding. Provide guidance to managers on HR policies, employee relations, and people-management matters. Coordinate with the company finance team and local payroll providers, and external partners to support accurate and timely HR administration. Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems, organizational information, and personnel documentation. Support compliance with local employment requirements in coordination with global HR leadership and local advisors. Assist with compensation reviews, employment agreements, benefits administration, and HR reporting. Support employee engagement, retention initiatives, and regional HR projects. Talent Acquisition & Recruiting Manage full-cycle recruitment for assigned positions across APAC. Partner with hiring managers to understand staffing needs, qualifications, and hiring priorities. Source and screen candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, and direct outreach. Coordinate interviews, candidate assessments, offers, and pre-employment requirements. Build talent pipelines for recurring and specialized positions. Maintain accurate requisition tracking, recruiting reports, and candidate records. Support headcount planning, position approvals, and workforce management. Identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes, candidate experience, and hiring efficiency. HR Operations & Process Improvement Help standardize HR practices and documentation across multiple countries. Collaborate with global HR colleagues on policies, systems, reporting, and process improvements. Monitor regional HR activities and proactively identify matters requiring attention. Support the development of scalable HR processes as the organization continues to grow. What We're Looking For: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field required; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered. Strong HR generalist experience covering employee relations, onboarding, HR administration, and employee lifecycle management. Demonstrated experience managing full-cycle recruitment. Experience supporting employees or business operations across multiple countries, preferably within APAC. Working knowledge of HR practices and employment requirements across Asian markets. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. Comfortable working with HR systems, recruiting platforms, and Microsoft Excel. Strong English communication skills; additional Asian languages are an advantage. Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, transportation, or an international service organization is preferred. What Makes This Opportunity Different? You'll have the opportunity to influence how HR operates across an entire region. This is not a recruiting-only position or a traditional administrative HR role. You'll be involved in real business decisions, work directly with managers across different countries, and help create practical solutions to everyday HR challenges. You'll also contribute to improving our regional HR infrastructure, developing more consistent processes, and supporting the continued growth of our international workforce. We value people who take initiative, exercise sound judgment, and understand that effective HR is about supporting both employees and the business. Who Will Succeed Here? Someone who enjoys variety, takes ownership, and is comfortable moving between employee relations, recruiting, HR operations, and business support. review_candidates.title: Product Marketing Manager
review_candidates.description: About AngelList Private markets are the new public markets. The most important companies of this era are private, and almost no one can own them. What's missing is the financial system public markets spent a century building: exchanges, custodians, brokers, and ways for ordinary people to buy in. Private markets, now $28T, never had the equivalent. AngelList is building it. The last decade of structural innovation in venture happened here: syndicates, SPVs at scale, Rolling Funds, scout programs. Today we have $200B+ in assets and 30,000+ startups funded on our platform. The rest of private markets is next. Funds is the software and services behind private funds, Nova is the banking network, Meridian is the wealth platform for accredited investors, and USVC is the brand behind a registered fund that lets anyone invest in venture. Working here means an unusual amount of agency on a problem that matters. Titles are closer to suggestions, and there are about 200 of us building what private markets never had. Come build it with us. About The Role AngelList supports more than $200B in assets across 30,000+ funds and syndicates, with over $80B moved through our banking infrastructure. Our network includes 2,300+ GPs and 72,000+ LPs, and more than a decade of private-market transaction data sits underneath the platform. The opportunity now is to turn that scale, knowledge, and customer trust into a stronger market position and a durable source of growth. We are looking for a senior, hands-on marketing leader to build the positioning, launch rhythm, campaigns, and distribution behind AngelList’s businesses. You’ll start with Funds. AngelList supports everything from a founder’s first SPV to $500M institutional funds, but many of the firms we want to serve next formed their view of us years ago, when AngelList was best known as where emerging managers got started. Your first challenge is to change that perception without losing what made the brand valuable. Nova, the banking network underpinning private markets, comes next. You’ll work directly with Product on what we are building and why it matters, with Sales on why important deals are won and lost, and with the GMs and operators who know our customers best. Your job is to turn what AngelList knows into positioning, proof, and programs that change how the market sees us—and ultimately change customer behavior, pipeline, and revenue. You’ll write the positioning, build campaigns, talk to customers, and lead important launches. For the right marketer, it is a rare amount of leverage. What You’ll Own Shape the story. Develop positioning and messaging for AngelList and its businesses. Make sophisticated financial products easy to understand and hard to dismiss. Lead important launches. Own the narrative, enablement, content, distribution, and measurement around the product and company moments that matter. Turn proof into persuasion. Bring customer outcomes, institutional logos, migration results, product advantages, and market data into the buying process. Publish what AngelList knows. Turn proprietary data and in-house expertise into useful, opinionated work that GPs and LPs share with one another. Build durable distribution. Develop and test programs across content, customer networks, events, search, partnerships, and channels we have not tried yet. Partner deeply with Sales. Understand why we win, why we lose, and where the story breaks. Build marketing and enablement that improve those outcomes. Establish a consistent shipping rhythm. Put meaningful work into the market every week, learn from the response, and reinvest behind what works. What We’re Looking For You are an exceptional product marketer and writer. You can get deep into a complicated business, find the thing that matters, and explain it plainly. You have substantial experience in product, growth, or integrated B2B marketing, including positioning, launches, and campaigns you led end to end. You have managed marketers or external partners while continuing to produce important work yourself. You have marketed to sophisticated B2B buyers—such as funds, finance teams, or CFOs—where buying decisions are considered and the target market is specific enough to name. You care equally about story and distribution. You know that a strong narrative is only valuable if the right people encounter it. You have strong commercial instincts. You care whether the work changes customer behavior, creates qualified opportunities, and contributes to revenue, assets, or transaction volume. You create direction in ambiguous situations and become credible quickly by talking to customers, salespeople, product leaders, and operators. You use data with discipline without pretending attribution is more precise than it is. You have high standards, move quickly, and prefer doing excellent work to managing a large machine. Working Here If you don’t meet every requirement above, we still encourage you to apply. We value complementary strengths and operators who learn by doing. AngelList has offices in a few cities, New York City and San Francisco. We have a hybrid in-office model: teammates come in at least 2 days per week (Tuesdays and either Wednesday or Thursday). Compensation The compensation for this role consists of a competitive base salary, benefits, and equity package. The base salary for this role is $140,000+ annually but actual will vary based on a number of factors including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Full details about our Total Rewards package will be provided during the recruitment process. Benefits We support your life both in and outside of work. review_candidates.title: OPI-VRI (Spanish - English) Medical Interpreter
review_candidates.description: Company Description Future Group Language Solutions is part of Future Group, a global leader in digital experience solutions that combine human expertise with advanced AI. With over 30 years of industry experience, the company helps individuals and organizations communicate across cultures and expand internationally. Future Group delivers integrated solutions in technology, language services, and multicultural marketing, guided by Shariah-compliant ethical principles. Its mission is to enable sustainable growth for businesses, particularly in emerging markets, while fostering meaningful global connections. The organization emphasizes AI innovation, cultural intelligence, and scalable solutions to meet diverse client needs. Role Description The Spanish English Medical Interpreter OPI-VRI is a full-time remote role responsible for providing accurate, impartial interpretation between Spanish and English in medical settings via over-the-phone and video remote platforms. Day-to-day tasks include facilitating communication between patients and healthcare professionals, ensuring medical information, diagnoses, treatment plans, and consent forms are clearly understood by all parties. The interpreter will follow established protocols, maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries, and adhere to industry and organizational standards for quality and ethics. The role also involves preparing for assignments by reviewing relevant terminology, handling urgent and routine calls effectively, and documenting work as required. Collaboration with coordinators and adherence to schedule commitments are key aspects of this position. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Medical Interpretation and Interpreting skills, with proven ability to work in clinical and healthcare environments. Candidates should possess proficiency in Medical Terminology related to various specialties, enabling clear and accurate communication. Candidates should possess Simultaneous Interpretation skills for real-time conversations, along with the ability to perform consecutive interpretation when needed. Candidates should possess Translation abilities for short medical documents or patient information when required. Native or near-native proficiency in Spanish and English, with excellent listening and speaking skills in both languages. Prior experience as a medical interpreter, preferably in OPI (over-the-phone interpreting) and VRI (video remote interpreting) contexts. Knowledge of interpreter ethics, confidentiality standards, and applicable healthcare regulations. Strong interpersonal skills, cultural sensitivity, and the ability to remain calm and professional in high-stress situations. Reliable internet connection, suitable remote work environment, and comfort using digital communication platforms. Relevant certification in medical interpreting or completion of formal interpreter training is highly preferred.
